rationale: Round 2, ADR-conformance lens. I re-derived every claim against cb272d50 by reading only; no mutation probes were needed, so I created no detached checkout. All 19 of my round-1 asks are ADDRESSED in substance. (1) The ADR-0041 'Amendment (Spec 129)' is now priced correctly: it is appended rather than rewritten in place, follows the Spec-125 precedent, and is finalized with the citing bead. AC-18 pins it with a text test. It is scoped as follows: (i) the reachable-landing fallback serves MF-3 and reattest only, while §2(ii) CLOSE decisions (MergedUnclosed and complete's reconcile) stay first-parent, pinned by AC-11 (vi); (ii) a panel datum that does not match is NON-CORROBORATING in both FindLandedMerge and reattest, which removes the round-1 reattest deadlock (AC-12 (v)); (iii) the fourth-verb clause is formally amended, with no flagless re-claim. (2) ADR-0025 is now honest: the marker stores path, sha256 and bytes, never text. (3) The ADR-0035 recovery lines are fixed: the reparent is offered only when the bead has no parent, --evidence appears as a literal placeholder, the R1.3 recovery is asserted in AC-3, and `bd blocked --parent` is used. (4) R4.1 membership is now status-independent: three disjuncts read through internal/bead, and a read error fails closed, which closes the round-1 fail-open (AC-10 (d)(e)(g)). (5) ADR-0045 now names what it amends in ADR-0040 §1 and ADR-0044, reconciles with ADR-0040 §3, adds back-pointers in both, and carries an ADR-0032 Status fence. The fallback does not reintroduce a false PASS in my lens: candidates are pinned to bead/<id> as merge SOURCE, refresh merges are excluded, exact second-parent corroboration is unchanged, and the net-effect revert test at the tip is unchanged. My remaining asks are wording precision only, so I APPROVE with asks: the ADR-0044 back-pointer's 'staged content under Decision 5' makes current skills immediately non-compliant with Decision 5; the consumer table reads as if R4.3 leaves the CLOSE path unchanged, which it does not; ADR-0040's back-pointer says L3 is unchanged although ADR-0045 Decision 2 changes it; the touchpoint cites AC-17 where AC-18 pins the amendment; amendment (i) says 'target = spec branch', which cannot be verified for MergeInto's `Merge bead/<id>` subject; AC-11 (iii) is ambiguous.
concrete_changes_required: ADR-0044 back-pointer and ADR-0045 'Relation to ADR-0044': calling the five skills' conduct fragments 'staged content under ADR-0045 Decision 5' makes them non-compliant at once, because Decision 5 requires every staged rule to show its target gate/config/template ID and a removal date, and `doctor` reports any staged rule past its date. Either give those fragments their target (the `panel brief` template) and a date, or add a transition sentence to ADR-0045: content that predates ADR-0045 is grandfathered until Implementation order step 7, and the Decision 5 marking duty applies to NEW staged rules from the date ADR-0045 is accepted.

R4.2 consumer table / ADR-0041 amendment (ii): the 'unchanged' column covers R4.2 only. R4.3's set semantics live inside FindLandedMerge and so DO reach MergedUnclosed, which feeds complete's CLOSE reconcile and stale_open, and also reach planFindLandedMergeFn and adoptFindLandedMergeFn. State this, together with why it is safe for a §2(ii) CLOSE decision: a stale panel SHA used to contradict, and now either a tip/binding exact match confirms or the result is still a refusal (NoEvidence leading to attested-restore). Add one AC leg: MergedUnclosed with registrations {stale A} and surviving tip = second parent identifies the landing, and with {A} alone returns NoEvidence, not a close.

ADR-0041 amendment (i) wording: the 'target = spec branch' pin can only be checked for the git-default subject `Merge branch 'bead/<id>' into <spec-branch>`. gitutil.MergeInto's `Merge bead/<id>` carries no target. Say that for the MergeInto form the target is not encoded, and that the fallback's defence there is exact second-parent corroboration plus the net-effect test at the tip, not subject pinning.

ADR-0040 back-pointer: 'The ratchet direction and L1–L3 are unchanged' understates the change. ADR-0045 Decision 2 makes `instruct` (L3) the ONLY guidance channel, rendered from the rule table. Reword to 'L1 and L2 are unchanged; L3 gains Decision 2's sole-channel and rule-table source'.
ADR Touchpoints, ADR-0041 bullet: 'AC-17 pins it' should be AC-18. AC-17 is the ready-check marker AC; AC-18's fourth bullet is the amendment text-pin.

AC-11 (iii): state explicitly that X ALSO lands on spec/S by its own merge, and that the excluded `Merge branch 'bead/X' into bead/Y` neither identifies X nor creates a FIX-2b ambiguity. Add the negative case: X's ONLY path to the tip is through Y's landing, so X is NOT identified (ErrLandedMergeNoCandidate) and is not credited via Y.

findings.title: ADR-0041 Amendment (Spec 129) — judged sound
findings.detail: Placement follows the repo's amendment precedent: appended, cross-referenced from item (c), finalized by the citing bead, and text-pinned by AC-18. Scope (i) keeps §2(ii)'s CLOSE decisions first-parent and confines the fallback to MF-3 (a readiness gate) and reattest. Reattest writes a binding derived from an exact second-parent match, which is still admissible under the Spec-125 'independent git EXACT-second-parent match' rule. No CLOSE consumer nominates that merge, so it cannot become a close. Scope (ii) is set-confirm-on-exact plus non-corroborating otherwise; tip and binding contradictions are kept, so it cannot confirm an ancestor (settled fact 4). Scope (iii) moves claim authority to a fresh flag plus evidence only, which matches ADR-0040 L1's journaled-hatch shape.

findings.title: ADR-0044 back-pointer makes existing skills non-compliant with ADR-0045 Decision 5
findings.detail: ADR-0045 Decision 5: a staged rule 'must show the ID of its target gate or config key, and a removal date', and doctor reports a staged rule past its date. The new ADR-0044 blockquote and ADR-0045 'Relation to ADR-0044' declare the five skills' conduct fragments 'staged content under Decision 5', yet none of them carries a target ID or a date. The same applies to every skill rule that predates ADR-0045, and the ADR states no grandfather or transition clause.

findings.title: R4.3 reaches the CLOSE path, but the consumer table reads 'unchanged'
findings.detail: The table's 'unchanged' rows (MergedUnclosed and complete's reconcile, stale_open, plan.go, adopt_lattice.go) are true for R4.2's fallback only. R4.3 edits reviewedHeadSHAForBead and FindLandedMerge's panel leg, and every one of those consumers calls FindLandedMerge. The behaviour change is a safe relaxation: confirmation still needs an exact tip or binding match, and a panel-only mismatch moves from one refusal to another. Still, ADR-0041 §2(ii) governs CLOSE evidence, so the effect should be stated and pinned.

findings.title: Amendment (i) target pin is not checkable for the MergeInto subject form
findings.detail: gitutil.MergeInto (gitops.go) writes `Merge %s` with the source branch only. The admitted `Merge bead/<id>` form carries no target, so 'with the spec branch as its target' holds only for git's default `Merge branch 'bead/<id>' into <spec-branch>`. This is not a false PASS in my lens: exact second-parent corroboration and the net-effect test at the tip still apply. The amendment text should claim exactly that.

findings.title: ADR-0040 back-pointer says L3 is unchanged
findings.detail: ADR-0045 Decision 2 ('mindspec instruct is the only guidance channel ... generated from the same rule table') changes ADR-0040 §1's L3 description. The back-pointer says 'L1–L3 are unchanged'.

findings.title: AC-11 (iii) is ambiguous on how X lands
findings.detail: R4.2 excludes 'a merge into another bead'. AC-11 (iii) says that after `Merge branch 'bead/X' into bead/Y` 'both X and Y are identified'. That holds only if X also lands by its own merge. If X's only route to the tip is through Y, X must be NoCandidate. The AC should say which case it means and pin the negative.
